phase: phase C: the declared sweep and the classes

entries.case: B4 the declared default
entries.detail: with no axis option: 4 sources, 5 densities, 20 seeds, 1000 ticks, 400 cells, defaulted_axes ['sources', 'densities', 'seeds', 'ticks']

entries.case: B4 a given axis leaves the other three defaulted
entries.detail: with --seeds 0-2: defaulted_axes ['sources', 'densities', 'ticks'], seeds [0, 1, 2], 60 cells

entries.case: B3 cell enumeration and order
entries.detail: 400 cells enumerated, 400 rows in rule 4.3 order, and --jobs 4 produced byte-identical output (275132 bytes)

entries.case: B11 no ambient value in a cell record
entries.detail: 400 cell records checked field by field and by pattern for a path, a timestamp, a duration, a process identifier and an environment name; findings none

entries.case: B6 nine usage errors
entries.detail: all 9 of rule 15.1's conditions exited 2, wrote nothing and each said why; the stand-in binary recorded 0 invocations across all nine; faults none

entries.case: Q2 each predicate fires, and the order carries meaning
entries.detail: five fixtures assigned ['extinction', 'famine', 'asymmetric_collapse', 'collapse', 'coexistence']; a row satisfying clause 1 and clause 4 was assigned 'extinction' by clause 1; faults none

entries.case: Q8 class counts sum to the row count
entries.detail: 6 groups, six counters each (five classes and unclassified); mismatches none

entries.case: Q11 an unobserved class is stated as zero
entries.detail: over rows in which no run meets the predicate, famine is present in every group with count 0 and is omitted from none (1 groups)

entries.case: Q10 attempted stays distinct
entries.detail: every group states attempted and effective separately for all three kinds; no key merges them (confirmed)

entries.case: Q4 a missing fact
entries.detail: a row without roster was reported 'unclassified' with reason 'missing fact: roster', and was not classified on the fields present

entries.case: Q13 two engines are two experiments
entries.detail: two rows differing only in engine produced 2 groups keyed ['0.1.0', '0.2.0'], never merged, at one source and one density

entries.case: Q14 small and empty groups
entries.detail: a one-row group is reported with its order statistics equal ({'min': 8, 'median': 8, 'max': 8}); a sweep with no rows produced 0 groups at status 0 rather than an error

entries.case: Q12 the sweep travels
entries.detail: the sweep record is restated whole (10 fields) with density 0.10 that produced no row; the engine version is stated on every group

entries.case: Q9 both axes from the same rows
entries.detail: the same 12 rows aggregated over source (2 groups) and over density (2 groups); each group states rule 17.1's counts and order statistics

entries.case: Q15 classifier determinism
entries.detail: two runs over the same rows with the same options produced byte-identical output (6549 bytes)

entries.case: P3 classification is a function of the row
entries.detail: the row classified alone is 'coexistence' by clause 5, and identical within a 12-row file

entries.case: Q6 revisability, by digest
entries.detail: the classes changed from ['coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence', 'coexistence'] to ['collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse', 'collapse'] while the retained rows' digest stayed e4fb3348aed830e6... throughout

entries.case: Scenario 3 a threshold is revised after publication
entries.detail: the regenerated distribution differs from the published one, the rows are byte-identical, and reverting the edit reproduces the original distribution byte for byte

entries.case: Q3 the residual, and its removal
entries.detail: a row matching none of clauses 1 to 4 is coexistence by clause 5; with clause 5 removed it is 'unclassified' because 'no clause matched', still present as one of one rows and counted as unclassified rather than defaulted or dropped

entries.case: P4 rows are immutable
entries.detail: 4 retained files digested, then read by the classifier three ways each; changed none

entries.case: Q7 rows alone
entries.detail: the classifier ran from a directory holding nothing -- no target/, no stream, no checkout -- and produced a distribution at status 0; its source names none of the process or network tokens (confirmed absent)

entries.case: Q5 no judgement in a row
entries.detail: rule 16.5's whole vocabulary and every judgement word checked by pattern over 400 shim rows and every engine-produced row of two sweeps; findings none
